# Roasted Tomato Soup

Late summer, when tomatoes are cheap and plentiful, is the only time worth making this. Roasting them first is what separates this from the canned stuff.

Serves 4

## Ingredients

- 3 lbs ripe tomatoes, halved
- 1 onion, quartered
- 6 garlic cloves, unpeeled
- olive oil
- 2 cups vegetable or chicken stock
- 2 tbsp tomato paste
- a few basil leaves
- salt and pepper
- cream, optional, for serving

## Method

Preheat the oven to 400F. Arrange the tomatoes, onion and garlic on a sheet pan, drizzle heavily with olive oil, and season with salt and pepper.

Cook time: 50 minutes in the oven, until the tomatoes are collapsed and charred in spots and the onion is soft.

Squeeze the garlic out of their skins. Transfer everything, garlic included, to a blender along with the stock and tomato paste. Blend until smooth, working in batches if needed.

Pour into a pot, warm it through, and taste for salt. Tear in the basil right before serving. A swirl of cream on top is nice but not required.

Notes: don't skip the roasting step even when you're in a hurry, it's most of the flavor in this recipe.
